## Coalition Lattices for Interpretable Machine Learning

In interpretable machine learning, breakdown plots and Shap-values can be seen
as different methods applied to a so-called coalition lattice. These notes show
how to create a coalition lattice and how to derive different post-hoc
interpretations from it, with a worked example on an ensemble of five trees
(August 2026, 19 pages).
